name: Ingéniosité divine/Événement Web
description: A mysterious domain has appeared on the outskirts of Mondstadt. They say that you can redesign it at will. Let your imagination run free when customizing your very own Custom Domain! At the same time, the "Divine Ingenuity" Interaction Platform is available for a limited time. You can present your own Custom Domains by uploading videos and images of your Domains to the platform. You can also view other Travelers' Domains and select your favorite Domains to challenge them in-game. You can even upload the recordings of your challenges! Showcase your wonderful imagination and exchange Domain design ideas with other Travelers!
